issue_request: FHIR-11273 was a Published FHIR-I Change Request resolved Persuasive. It asked to fix the references-page contained-resource example because the text described a Condition with only limited primary-surgeon information, while the example resource used a Composition containing an Organization.

additional_context: source/references.html is in current build scope through the active source/fhir.ini type-page mapping reference=references. The current source still contains the primary-surgeon Condition scenario and matching Condition/Practitioner examples. Later Published issue FHIR-22627 questioned this same example but was resolved Not Persuasive with Modification because FHIR-I considered it an excellent contained-resource example; FHIR-22627 is already represented on the combined branch by d7f9c2eb9d0bb76a48051f45c592197d86cc3061. Focused Zulip and Confluence searches found no conflicting community decision record.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The original mismatch identified by FHIR-11273 is no longer present in the authoritative references-page source, and later review supports keeping the aligned Condition/Practitioner example.
